title: Freight quote
subtitle: Prices a shipment from the trip cost, with margin and the ANTT minimum floor. Read-only: nothing is saved.

quote.title: Calculate a quote
quote.hint: Enter the distance and the vehicle. Tolls and the diesel price are optional: without a diesel price the company or ANP price is used.
quote.eightAxles: The norm has no 8-axle column: the floor uses the 7-axle one, per Art. 5 §5.

result.title: Result
result.shipmentCost: Cost of this shipment ({{share}}% of the trip)
result.floorApplied: Cost plus margin came out below the ANTT floor, so the freight uses the floor.

settings.title: Quote parameters
settings.hint: Market starting values for a three-axle truck on general cargo. Replace each with the real number from your operation.

why.marginPercent: Starting {{value}}%. Road freight usually runs at 10% to 20% of the selling price.
why.expectedOccupancyPercent: Starting {{value}}%. How full the vehicle usually runs: spreads the trip cost across shipments.
why.driverCostPerKm: Starting R$ {{value}}. Driver pay, charges and allowances divided by km driven.
why.maintenanceCostPerKm: Starting R$ {{value}}. Preventive and corrective maintenance per km.
why.tiresCostPerKm: Starting R$ {{value}}. Tires and retreading per km.
why.fixedCostPerKm: Starting R$ {{value}}. Depreciation, vehicle tax, insurance and tracker per km.
why.adValoremPercent: Starting {{value}}% of the cargo value. The market charges 0.1% to 0.5% for damage risk.
why.grisPercent: Starting {{value}}% of the cargo value. Risk management: 0.1% to 0.3%, more for targeted cargo.
why.fuelKmPerLiter: Leave empty to use the reference consumption by axles (from 4.5 km/l with 2 axles to 1.9 with 9).

settings.applyAnttFloor: Never charge below the ANTT minimum floor
settings.anttSource: The floor follows {{resolution}}, in force since {{date}}. The table is law and changes with a system update, not on this screen.
settings.readOnly: Only company administrators change the parameters.

errors.RESPONSE_INVALID: The server answered in an unexpected format.
errors.FREIGHT_QUOTE_FUEL_PRICE_MISSING: No diesel price. Enter one in the field or set it under Company > Fuel.
errors.FREIGHT_QUOTE_OCCUPANCY_INVALID: Expected occupancy must be between 0 and 100%.
errors.FREIGHT_QUOTE_SHARE_INVALID: The vehicle share must be between 0 and 100%.
errors.FREIGHT_QUOTE_DISTANCE_INVALID: The distance must be greater than zero.
errors.FREIGHT_QUOTE_FUEL_PRICE_INVALID: The diesel price must be greater than zero.
errors.FREIGHT_QUOTE_CONSUMPTION_INVALID: The consumption must be greater than zero.
